articles.title: Iranian University Students Stage Rare Protest
articles.description: Dozens of university students staged a rare protest in Iran, where the authorities have waged an intensifying campaign against dissent.
articles.content:
Dozens of university students staged a rare protest in Iran, where the authorities have waged an intensifying campaign against dissent amid the war with the United States.
